summary: Update Jira Support project fields + templates to align with Escalation Playbook v2 (required fields, SLA due dates, link conventions)
description:
Goal
Update Jira (Customer Support + Internal Support projects) to match Escalation Playbook v2 so escalations are consistently actionable and SLA tracking is automatic.

Background
During Feb 2026 discovery, repeated escalations (streaming disconnects, 429 spikes, Private SSO) lacked required metadata (request IDs, model/version, region/environment, impact window). SLA expectations by tier are being standardized; we need Jira to reflect the new due-date rules and required-field conventions.

Scope
1) Fields / required metadata (Customer Support project)
- Add/confirm these fields are present + visible on Create/Edit + required when Priority=P0/P1 OR Severity set:
  - Customer tier (self_serve / dedicated / private / enterprise)
  - Environment (prod/staging) + Region (us-east, eu-west, etc.)
  - Affected model(s) + pinned model version (if applicable)
  - Request IDs / trace IDs (free text, allow multiple)
  - Impact start time (timestamp) + current status (ongoing/mitigated/resolved)
  - Error signature (5xx, timeout, streaming disconnect, 429/throttling, auth/SSO, capacity)
  - Repro steps (if client-side)
  - Links: Slack thread, incident ID (if declared), dashboards/logs

2) Templates
- Update Issue Create templates for:
  - Support Request (default)
  - Bug (support found)
  - Incident (support-triggered)
- Description template should align 1:1 with Confluence “Jira ticket template and required fields”.

3) SLA due dates / automation
- Implement/validate date automation fields for customer-support issues:
  - first_response_due_at
  - sla_due_at (time-to-mitigation target)
- Rules should be tier-aware and priority-aware (final targets per PM-612). Interim rules (pilot) until enterprise language is finalized:
  - P0: first_response_due_at = created_at + 15m (enterprise/private/dedicated), + 60m (self_serve)
  - P1: first_response_due_at = created_at + 30m (enterprise/private/dedicated), + 4h (self_serve)
  - sla_due_at (mitigation): placeholder values until PM-612 sign-off; store + display but do not enforce breach notifications externally yet.
- Add SLA fields to default screens and board card layout for Support.

4) Link conventions
- Standardize how we link related artifacts:
  - Slack: require channel + thread link for P0/P1 (e.g., #support thread URL, #incidents thread URL)
  - Incidents: if incident declared, require related_incident_id field to be populated
  - GitHub: PR links go in “related_github_prs” (or dedicated field if available)
  - Confluence: runbook/playbook links in “related_confluence_pages”

Out of scope
- Changes to the oncall/incident process itself (handled by SRE + playbook rollout)
- Public-facing help center updates (Docs pipeline)

Acceptance criteria
- Creating a P0/P1 customer-support issue prompts for the escalation-required fields (cannot submit without them, or at minimum triggers a clearly visible checklist + automation reminder).
- Default templates updated and referenced in the Support onboarding/training deck.
- first_response_due_at and sla_due_at auto-populate for customer-support issues per agreed pilot rules.
- Ticket includes consistent artifact links (Slack/Incident/GitHub/Confluence) using agreed conventions.

Notes / dependencies
- Dependency: PM-612 for final external SLA language; implement pilot automation now but keep change log and ability to adjust.
- Dependency: ENG-2842 “required fields lint/checklist” and ENG-2843 incident-bot workflow; ensure Jira template matches bot prompts.

Requested by
Dev Patel (Support), for Escalation Playbook v2 rollout + known-issues sprint.

References
- SUP-4921 (streaming disconnects): missing request IDs + region/model on first escalation
- SUP-4923 (Private SSO): missing environment + IdP change details; sensitive handling needed
- SUP-4925 (5xx): incident vs escalation confusion; inconsistent incident ID linking
comments: 2026-02-11 10:18 PT — Dev Patel (reporter): Creating INT to track Jira-side changes needed for Escalation Playbook v2. Support is seeing repeat escalations with missing req IDs / model / region which slows SRE engagement. Please treat this as a rollout blocker for week 4 training if not landed by then.

2026-02-11 13:02 PT — Chris Osei (Product Ops): Added to weekly Support+SRE review agenda. For reporting, we need first_response_due_at + sla_due_at to exist and be reliably populated so we can compare to internal MTTA/MTTM (see SRE metrics sheet).

2026-02-12 09:41 PT — Owen Phillips (assignee): I can take point on Jira config. Quick clarification: do we want hard required fields (cannot transition out of Triage) vs soft required (checklist + bot nag)? Hard-required at Create tends to increase back-and-forth on self-serve tickets where customers can’t provide req IDs immediately.

2026-02-12 10:06 PT — Dev Patel: Preference: hard-required for P0/P1 once we set Priority (support controls that). For new inbound tickets (Priority not set yet), soft required is fine. As soon as we escalate or set Sev/P0/P1, we should enforce the minimum metadata.

2026-02-13 15:24 PT — Rafael Mendes (SRE): +1 on enforcement at escalation time. Biggest pain is being paged with “timeouts in prod” and no region/model/request IDs. If enforcement is too heavy, at least block the “Escalation requested” transition until required fields are filled.

2026-02-16 11:33 PT — Owen Phillips: Drafted proposed field list + screen changes. Open questions:
1) Do we add a single multi-line “Request IDs / trace IDs” field or separate structured fields?
2) Do we want a dedicated “Error signature” dropdown (429/5xx/timeout/streaming/auth/capacity/other) for faster routing + metrics?
3) Where should customer comms cadence live (field vs SOP only)?

2026-02-16 12:10 PT — Priya Shah (Support Eng): Strong preference for an “Error signature” dropdown; it helps us map directly to Known Issues pages (streaming/429/capacity). For request IDs, one multi-line field is fine as long as we can paste multiple IDs and it’s searchable.

2026-02-18 09:22 PT — Owen Phillips: Met with Jira admins. Plan:
- Add “Error signature” single-select + “Pinned model version” short text
- Confirm existing fields for region/environment/model; adjust to be on Create/Edit screens
- Implement workflow validator on transition “Triage -> In Progress” AND on “Escalate to Eng/SRE” to check: tier, env+region, model, impact window, request IDs (or explicit note ‘customer unable to provide’), Slack thread link
- Add automation to populate first_response_due_at based on Priority + Tier (pilot values pending PM-612)
- Add SLA fields to card layout + issue navigator columns
ETA: config changes by 2026-02-24, then 2–3 days for Support to test in staging Jira project.

2026-02-20 14:55 PT — Dev Patel: Works. Please ensure we do not force customers to provide internal-only info. If request IDs aren’t available, required field should allow “N/A — customer cannot provide; asked on <date>” so we can proceed while tracking the gap.

2026-02-23 16:18 PT — Owen Phillips: Update: Field + screen changes are in staging. Workflow validators in progress. I’ll post screenshots + a test checklist in #support once ready; aiming for Support validation (Priya + Owen) by end of week. PM-612 still pending final mitigation-time targets; first_response_due_at automation can ship as pilot now.
